text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Greeted by thunderous applause, Eishin 
Flash smiled as she talked about becoming 
an impenetrable "wall" against the 
pursuers behind her, brimming with the 
pride of a victor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The schedule ahead is completely blank. 
How should she walk this path, and in what 
direction...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortsetzung folgt— It all depends on the 
two of them.
